before_text: Every required subject in release/v26.9.25/closure.json is terminal and the release closure court evaluates ALIVE (RFC §38 dispositions; omission is never success).
after_text: Every required subject in release/v26.9.25/closure.json has a terminal disposition: ALIVE/FINAL, or a typed SUPERSEDED/BLOCKED/UNSUPPORTED/REFUSED row (type + broken_term + RFC §39 class + owner); UNKNOWN or untyped is refused (RFC §5, §38; omission is never success).

derivation_terms.before: terminal AND the release closure court evaluates ALIVE: a strict strengthening of the §48 premise (a typed BLOCKED row is terminal under §38 yet keeps the closure court BLOCKED)
derivation_terms.after: terminal disposition per RFC §38 (ALIVE/FINAL or typed SUPERSEDED/BLOCKED/UNSUPPORTED/REFUSED), UNKNOWN or untyped refused: the §48 premise itself
